dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave trailing edge with high-degree curvature from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a near-zero pixel radius at the peak.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 50-60 degrees relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width is roughly equivalent to maximum vertical height, approximately 1.0.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius convexity with a gradual slope from the blowhole region to the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thickened beak with a low length-to-thickness ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle measured at the junction of the melon and the upper rostrum margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Low-polygon digital mesh artifacting and faceted shading across the lateral surface.
